effective_cuff_geometry_evaluation.scope: evaluation only; truth never fed to fit/controller

prediction.interpretation: TASK data not used by commissioning; retrospective finite-difference torque prediction, not a future-state forecast. Prequential model captured before that sample could update parameters. Torque is reconstructed with current effective geometry, not evaluation truth.

model_endpoints.endpoint_distinction: Final updater can include an update after the final executed control command; actual consumption is independently hashed.

metric_comparison_warning: Only full valid trajectories ranked by integral; entry-only/short values retained as evidence, not task quality.
